mapper.select: SELECT id, source, ingestion_mode, external_id, fingerprint, resource_id, alarm_name, severity, status, occurrence_count, first_occurred_at, last_occurred_at, ingested_at, service_code, environment, raw_payload, sample_payloads FROM alarm WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, source, ingestion_mode, external_id, fingerprint, resource_id, alarm_name, severity, status, occurrence_count, first_occurred_at, last_occurred_at, ingested_at, service_code, environment, raw_payload, sample_payloads FROM alarm WHERE fingerprint = #{fingerprint} ORDER BY last_occurred_at DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO alarm (source, ingestion_mode, external_id, fingerprint, resource_id, alarm_name, severity, status, occurrence_count, first_occurred_at, last_occurred_at, service_code, environment, raw_payload, sample_payloads) VALUES (#{source}, #{ingestionMode}, #{externalId}, #{fingerprint}, #{resourceId}, #{alarmName}, #{severity}, #{status}, #{occurrenceCount}, #{firstOccurredAt}, #{lastOccurredAt}, #{serviceCode}, #{environment}, #{rawPayload}, #{samplePayloads})
mapper.update: UPDATE alarm SET occurrence_count = occurrence_count + 1, last_occurred_at = #{lastOccurredAt}, sample_payloads = COALESCE(#{samplePayloads}, sample_payloads) WHERE id = #{id}
